title: Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance Value Factors: Return of Premium Vesting, Residual Death Benefit and Claim Interest
content:
**Ashgrove CareAssure value factors (Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance)**

Three sets of factors are fixed per tier: the return of premium vesting share used for surrender value, stated as a share of premiums paid for each policy year with the last entry applying thereafter; the residual death benefit, a share of the specified amount always payable at death regardless of benefits paid, subject to a dollar cap with the lesser of the two applying; and the simple annual interest rate on death proceeds from death to disbursement.

**Table A — return of premium vesting share by policy year**

| Tier | Year 1 | Year 2 | Year 3 | Year 4 | Year 5 and thereafter |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year | 0.80 | 0.85 | 0.90 | 0.95 | 1.00 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 3-Year | 0.80 | 0.85 | 0.90 | 0.95 | 1.00 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 4-Year | 0.80 | 0.85 | 0.90 | 0.95 | 1.00 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year | 0.80 | 0.85 | 0.90 | 0.95 | 1.00 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | 0.80 | 0.85 | 0.90 | 0.95 | 1.00 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | 0.80 | 0.85 | 0.90 | 0.95 | 1.00 |

**Table B — residual death benefit and death-claim interest**

| Tier | Residual death benefit share of the specified amount | Residual death benefit cap | Death-claim interest rate (simple, annual) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year | 0.10 | $10000 | 0.035 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 3-Year | 0.10 | $10000 | 0.035 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 4-Year | 0.10 | $10000 | 0.035 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year | 0.10 | $10000 | 0.035 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | 0.10 | $10000 | 0.035 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | 0.10 | $10000 | 0.035 |

In percent: the vesting shares are 80, 85, 90 and 95 percent in policy years 1 to 4 and 100 percent from policy year 5 on; the residual share is 10 percent; the interest rate is 3.5 percent a year.

**Residual death benefit, the lesser of the two (hypothetical specified amounts)**

| Specified amount | 10 percent of it | Cap | Residual death benefit |
|---|---|---|---|
| $50000 | $5000 | $10000 | $5000 |
| $100000 | $10000 | $10000 | $10000 |
| $250000 | $25000 | $10000 | $10000 |

From a specified amount of $100000 upward the cap governs; below it the 10 percent share governs.
